sentences.text: Shri Ajay Raghuwanshi - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Naval Kishor Gupta- Public Prosecutor for the St
This first application under section 483 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 has been filed for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested on 21/10/2024 in connection with Crime No.255/2021 registered at Police Station Piprai, District Ashoknagar (M.P.) for offence under Sections 363, 366-A, 370(4),
376(3), 120B, 120 and 34 of IPC, Section 3/4 of POCSO Act and Section 3(1)(w)(ii), 3(2)(va) and 3(2)(v) of SC/ST Act.
After arguing the matter at length, counsel for applicant seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this application with liberty to revive the prayer after prosecutrix is examined.
With aforesaid liberty, the application is dismissed as withdrawn.

(G. S. AHLUWALIA) JUDGE PjS/-
